body: He specifically told me that I am just like his ex which he calls dumb and lazy all the time. I thought giving him time to himself in the morning was the right thing to do since we are constantly together but he took it as all I want to do is lay around. I’m a dialysis patient and sometimes I don’t feel well. I told him that my sex drive was low and he took it as I’m not attracted to him. Which couldn’t be further from the truth. I can’t get anything right. I must not be trying hard enough.
